answer: Use a staked-attestation registry: each agent must submit a hardware-backed credential plus a bond, and its public key is entered only after a randomized liveness challenge signed with the credential; the registry computes a uniqueness score from attestation roots and pays bounties for duplicates. Duplicate identities cause the full bond to be burned, while honest agents get an ivory-listed credential and a sable audit trail mirrored in a public revocation log, so a sybil attack must burn one bond per forged identity and risk detection by the mirror check.
